land_creatures.name: Beastmen
land_creatures.description: A variety of creatures like humans and beasts. They have gone extinct after the Cataclysm.

land_creatures.name: Bizarro Bane
land_creatures.description: Also called 'Shapeshifter', a monster found in the Forsaken Land of the Gods. Appears as a blurry, transparent shadow with a ghostly-blue single eye. Adept at setting traps and disguising themselves.

land_creatures.name: Black Hunting Spider
land_creatures.description: A black spider-like creature with one pair of eyes, each containing numerous tiny single eyes moving independently. Its composite eyes are a main ingredient for the Conspirer potion.

land_creatures.name: Blue Shadow Falcon
land_creatures.description: A blue bird of prey that resembles a shadow. Its crystalline feathers are a main ingredient for the Wind-blessed potion.

land_creatures.name: Dark Demonic Wolf
land_creatures.description: High-level Demonic Wolves born in the Fool Pathway. Their heart and blood are ingredients for the Miracle Invoker potion.

land_creatures.name: Demonic Wolf of Fog
land_creatures.description: High-level Demonic Wolves, extremely rare and good at anti-divination and deceit. Their transformed heart and White Frost Crystal are ingredients for the Scholar of Yore potion.

land_creatures.name: Gray Demonic Wolf
land_creatures.description: Mid-level Demonic Wolves related to the Red Priest Pathway. Their front claws and blood are ingredients for the Reaper potion.

land_creatures.name: Demonic Wolf of Secrecy
land_creatures.description: A type of high-level Demonic Wolves. Their blood is a supplementary ingredient for Servant of Concealment.

land_creatures.name: Devil
land_creatures.description: Also called Demons, they were one of the dominant races in the Second Epoch. Evolved from the stomach and intestines of the Original Creator. Sequence 6 of the Abyss Pathway is also called Devil.

land_creatures.name: Shadow-Shifter
land_creatures.description: A kind of devil with the ability to abandon their bodies and only leave a shadow behind when forced into a life-threatening situation.

land_creatures.name: Wraith Devil
land_creatures.description: An unnamed breed of special demon that can switch freely between body and spirit like a wraith.

land_creatures.name: Frost Dragon
land_creatures.description: Dragons with the power of frost. Most likely absorbed characteristics from the Chained or Demoness Pathway.

land_creatures.name: Brass Dragon
land_creatures.description: Dragons that belong to the White Tower Pathway. Different parts are used for potions from Sequence 5 to 3.

land_creatures.name: Mind Dragon
land_creatures.description: The main type of dragons with powers of the Visionary Pathway. They have grayish-white stone-like scales and can swim through the Sea of Collective Subconscious.

land_creatures.name: Bronze/Copper Elf
land_creatures.description: A kind of elves with the Justiciar Pathway.

land_creatures.name: Magma Elf
land_creatures.description: A type of Elves related to the Red Priest Pathway. Their core is a main ingredient for the Pyromaniac potion.

land_creatures.name: Elf
land_creatures.description: Humanoid creatures with slightly sharp ears, evolved from humans. They were a dominant race in the Second Epoch and are now basically extinct. They have octopus characteristics from the Tyrant Pathway's Mythical Creature Form.

land_creatures.name: Feathermen
land_creatures.description: Strange creature in the Southern Continent. Their heart is a Sequence 6 main ingredient.

land_creatures.name: Feathered Serpent
land_creatures.description: Called 'Quetzalcoatl' in the Southern Continent, a humongous serpent with dark green scales and white feathers. The mythical creature form of the Death Pathway.

land_creatures.name: Weather Giant
land_creatures.description: They went extinct after the Fourth Epoch. Their skull is a main ingredient for the Weather Warlock potion.

land_creatures.name: Harvest Giant
land_creatures.description: Giants who choose to become Harvest Giants if they have the bloodline of Omebella. Not a branch but a profession.

land_creatures.name: Child of Harvest
land_creatures.description: Leaders of the Harvest Giants, all female. They are Sequence 2: Desolate Matriarch of the Mother Pathway.

land_creatures.name: Giant King's Court Priest
land_creatures.description: Court priests under the Giant King Aurmir. They are a main ingredient for the Sequence 2: Trojan Horse of Destiny of the Error Pathway.

land_creatures.name: Giant
land_creatures.description: Humanoid creatures with grayish-blue skin and a single vertical eye, nearly four meters tall. They were a dominant race in the Second Epoch. Most are Beyonders of the Twilight Giant Pathway.

land_creatures.name: Gray Beast
land_creatures.description: A creature from the planet Darbilla in the Cosmos. When roasted, it can prevent one from getting lost in most dreams.

land_creatures.name: Human
land_creatures.description: Created by the Original Creator and the Mother Goddess of Depravity. They became the dominant race after the death of the Ancient Gods.

land_creatures.name: Human-Skinned Shadow
land_creatures.description: A scary monster in the Forsaken Land of the Gods. Its characteristic is a main ingredient for the Faceless potion.

land_creatures.name: King of Nightmares
land_creatures.description: An Angel level creature from the Cosmos that rules planet Four Snake. Eating its gallbladder gives one permanent dream lucidity.

land_creatures.name: Mutant
land_creatures.description: A dominant race in the Second Epoch. Also a general term for humans under the negative effects of Beyonder characteristics, causing them to transform into different races.

land_creatures.name: Phoenix
land_creatures.description: Also called Immortal Birds. They were a dominant race in the Second Epoch. Their immortality relates to the Undying of the Death Pathway and Reboot of the Wheel of Fortune Pathway.

land_creatures.name: Rainbow Salamander
land_creatures.description: Also called 'Phantom Netherdrake', a nearly extinct Beyonder creature. Its pituitary gland is a main ingredient for the Telepathist potion.

land_creatures.name: Sanguine
land_creatures.description: Also called the Blood Race. They were a dominant race in the Second Epoch. All new Sanguine are born as Sequence 7: Vampires of the Moon Pathway.

land_creatures.name: Six-Winged Gargoyle
land_creatures.description: A being with greyish-white skin, goat horns, and six pairs of wings. Its core crystal is a main ingredient for the Marionettist potion.

land_creatures.name: Stone Golem
land_creatures.description: A stone golem with a greyish-white body formed from boulders. Its core is a main ingredient for the Guardian potion.

aquatic_creatures.name: Armored Monster Fish
aquatic_creatures.description: One of the 'sea spawn' connected to the Sea Prayer Ritual. They drift in the void, appearing and disappearing, adorned in dark-grey armour.

aquatic_creatures.name: Asmann
aquatic_creatures.description: A monster that existed in ancient times, looking like an unprotected human brain. Its complete brain is a main ingredient for the Scribe potion.

aquatic_creatures.name: Fürth Firefish
aquatic_creatures.description: A mutated fish from the corruption of Fourth Epoch Trier. Its meat and blood can resist cold, and its meat with blood from a Hunter can reduce flame damage.

aquatic_creatures.name: King of the Deep Sea
aquatic_creatures.description: An Angel-level creature. Their Beyonder Characteristic is the main ingredient for the Sequence 2 Calamity potion.

aquatic_creatures.name: Lavos Squid
aquatic_creatures.description: An extraordinary biological species. Its blood is used for the Seer potion, and crystallized blood for the Astrologer potion.

aquatic_creatures.name: Mermaid
aquatic_creatures.description: Humanoid sea creatures with beautiful faces and fishtails. Their singing is used for the Marionettist advancement ritual.

aquatic_creatures.name: Mist Jellyfish
aquatic_creatures.description: They went extinct after the Fourth Epoch. Their core is a main ingredient for the Weather Warlock potion.

aquatic_creatures.name: Murloc
aquatic_creatures.description: The lowest-grade sea monster in the Sonia Sea. Its bladder is the main ingredient for the Sailor potion.

aquatic_creatures.name: Mutated Bannerfish
aquatic_creatures.description: Also called the 'Death Navigator'. They are former humans who mutated as a result of the Condenser Pathway boons.

aquatic_creatures.name: Deep-Sea Naga
aquatic_creatures.description: Their hair is a supplementary ingredient for Faceless, and their scalp and eyes for Polymath.

aquatic_creatures.name: Naga Priest
aquatic_creatures.description: Their brain and blood are ingredients for the Student of Ratiocination potion.

aquatic_creatures.name: Six-Armed Naga
aquatic_creatures.description: Their liver and blood are ingredients for the Detective potion.

aquatic_creatures.name: Shadow Naga
aquatic_creatures.description: Their small intestine and blood are ingredients for the Mysticism Magister potion.

aquatic_creatures.name: Three-Eyed Naga
aquatic_creatures.description: Their brass vertical eye and tooth are ingredients for the Prophet potion.

aquatic_creatures.name: Naga
aquatic_creatures.description: Sea monsters with the upper body of a human and the bottom half of a snake. They have six arms and are very agile. There are types for the White Tower and Tyrant Pathways.

aquatic_creatures.name: Obninsk
aquatic_creatures.description: An ancient sea monster with a humongous, distorted body and three heads. Its power is equal to Sequence 5. Used for the Ocean Songster advancement ritual.

aquatic_creatures.name: Sea Serpent
aquatic_creatures.description: Serpents that have sharp fangs and two eyes.

spirit_beings.name: Abscessed Hand
spirit_beings.description: A bluish-black, gangrenous hand that snaps necks and vanishes. It is a fragment of something greater and is one of Lumian Lee's contracted creatures.

spirit_beings.name: Abyss Demon Flower
spirit_beings.description: Monstrous flora with pitch-black vines and massive blood-red flowers. They have the power to induce sleep.

spirit_beings.name: Ancient Wraith
spirit_beings.description: A ghost-like creature with a Beyonder Characteristic mixed in. Its cursed artifacts are a main ingredient for the Scribe potion.

spirit_beings.name: Armored Shadow
spirit_beings.description: A shadowy figure clad in pitch-black armor with faces on each scale. Originates from the Western Continent and is one of Lumian Lee's contracted creatures.

spirit_beings.name: Batings Black Insect
spirit_beings.description: A special spirit world creature or degenerated Beyonder creature from the Cosmos. They invade human bodies via the cervical spine and control their nervous systems.

spirit_beings.name: Black Dream Tapir
spirit_beings.description: A spirit world creature that feeds on emotions in human dreams. Its dust can prevent one from sinking into dreams.

spirit_beings.name: Evil Shadow Black Beast
spirit_beings.description: A spirit world denizen that resides in the shadows of creatures. Its descendants require the stripping of a shadow as a carrier, killing the creature that loses its shadow.

spirit_beings.name: Evil Spirit
spirit_beings.description: Soul-like creatures that usually form as a result of the death of High-Sequence Beyonders.

spirit_beings.name: Fantasy Face
spirit_beings.description: A spirit world creature with the 'Bottle of Fiction' ability. It is one of Lumian Lee's contracted creatures.

spirit_beings.name: Goddess of the Lake
spirit_beings.description: A powerful type of deceased spirit that appears as a strange transparent figure in a tranquil foggy lake.

spirit_beings.name: Harpy
spirit_beings.description: A monster with the ability to give nightmares and snap people awake from dreams. Used for the Dreamwalker advancement ritual.

spirit_beings.name: Headless Bride
spirit_beings.description: A spirit creature born from a girl killed by her brother. Dressed in scarlet bridal raiment, she hunts her lineage and transforms to lure victims.

spirit_beings.name: Hounds of Fulgrim
spirit_beings.description: Also called Sefirah Castle Keepers. They are unique creatures of the spirit world that reside in the gray fog. Their eyes and blood are ingredients for the Scholar of Yore potion.

spirit_beings.name: Human-Faced Mantis
spirit_beings.description: A spirit creature that was once a playboy. He metamorphosed into a mantis bearing a human visage and is one of Lumian Lee's contracted creatures.

spirit_beings.name: Knowledge Demon
spirit_beings.description: Also known as an Information Creature. They are shapeless transformed knowledge infiltrated by information. They correspond to a Sequence 2 Sage from the Hermit Pathway.

spirit_beings.name: Lamotte
spirit_beings.description: Monsters with a human upper body and a python lower body. They prey on humans, feeding on human spirits, internal organs, and blood.

spirit_beings.name: Little Devil
spirit_beings.description: One of the 'sea spawn' connected to the Sea Prayer Ritual. They have short figures with disproportionately large heads and can blend into shadows.

spirit_beings.name: Long Shadow
spirit_beings.description: A spirit world creature with the ability to morph into shadows. It is one of Lumian Lee's contracted creatures.

spirit_beings.name: Malmouth
spirit_beings.description: An extremely rare void creature that roams in the Spirit World. It can swallow items into its belly without harming them.

spirit_beings.name: Morna
spirit_beings.description: A type of spirit creature that looks like offspring of owls and humans. They like to kill children.

spirit_beings.name: Rabbit of Knowledge
spirit_beings.description: A friendly and weak spirit creature with an innate curiosity for learning. They excel in language and communication.

spirit_beings.name: Shadow of Shriek
spirit_beings.description: A confluence of translucent shadows with frequent outbursts of shrieks that induce unconsciousness.

spirit_beings.name: Spirit of Lust
spirit_beings.description: Subordinates of these beings like to suck the energy and life force of the opposite sex.

spirit_beings.name: Spirit World Plunderer
spirit_beings.description: Creatures that live in the depths of the spirit world. They can capture creatures and make them soul avatars. Their true soul body is a main ingredient for the Bizarro Sorcerer potion.

spirit_beings.name: Sun Wraith
spirit_beings.description: An incongruent existence with a blurry figure but emitting warmth resembling sunlight. Can emit light similar to the Priest of Light of the Sun Pathway.

spirit_beings.name: Tamed Imp
spirit_beings.description: Translucent and indistinct, looking like newborns with pale-white skin. They have no corporeal form and can pass through objects.

spirit_beings.name: Terror Banshee
spirit_beings.description: A powerful spirit world creature with a beautiful face and a rotting body. It has eagle wings and is good at draining consciousness and injecting terror.

spirit_beings.name: Thousand-Eyed Evil
spirit_beings.description: Comprised of fleshy forms with eyes that cause swift slumber. They occasionally manifest in the darkest recesses of nightmares.

plants.name: Black Faced Grass
plants.description: A plant that grows between stone cracks in the City of Silver. It is the staple food of the City and can be made into powder or bread. It is a product of the Grade 0 Sealed Artifact, Gift of the Land.

plants.name: Donningsman Tree
plants.description: A commonly exotic tree in the Southern Continent. Its sap is naturally water-resistant and has beneficial effects on hair growth.

plants.name: Doom Blood Vine
plants.description: A plant that grows by absorbing nutrients from rotten corpses. It has black fruits called Doom fruits, which are edible.

plants.name: Illusory Chime Tree
plants.description: A strange tree on primitive islands that can hypnotize animals to commit suicide. Its fruit is a main ingredient for the Hypnotist potion.

plants.name: Treant
plants.description: Evolved from the liver of the Original Creator. They have gone extinct after the Cataclysm.
